title: Canonical valid ReadPropertyMultiple request analogue
purpose: Provide a complete BACnet/IP confirmed-request entry seed for ReadPropertyMultiple with a compact but nested object-plus-property-list style payload analogue suitable for mutation.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP implementation should recognize a confirmed request carrying service choice 0x0e and continue into ReadPropertyMultiple service decoding with a non-empty nested request body.
constraints_preserved: BVLC type is 0x81 and BVLC function is 0x0a.
NPDU version 0x01 and control 0x00 are present.
APDU first octet uses confirmed-request PDU type 0x00 in the high nibble.
issue_safety_notes: This stays request-side and avoids the exact 1-byte truncated RPM crash shape described in the supplied RPM issue.
